endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_selectorFamilyKernel
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r K : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (M : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) {C₀ δ κ : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C₀ →
        0 ≤ κ →
          δ ≤ s.bandwidth →
            RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V μ) C₀ δ κ →
              ∀ (c : (Fin (K + 1) → RectangleCLT.Face p) → RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
                (∀ (α : Fin (K + 1) → RectangleCLT.Face p), Measurable (c α)) →
                  (∀ (α : Fin (K + 1) → RectangleCLT.Face p) (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), 0 ≤ c α g) →
                    ∀ (B : RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
                      Measurable B →
                        (∀ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), 0 ≤ B g) →
                          MeasureTheory.Integrable B (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) →
                            (∀ (α : Fin (K + 1) → RectangleCLT.Face p) (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), c α g ≤ B g) →
                              (∀ (α : Fin (K + 1) → RectangleCLT.Face p),
                                  (Measurable fun ω =>
                                      ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                        c α g *
                                          RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α
                                            (V ω + M.mulVec g) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) ∧
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                      (fun ω =>
                                        ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                          c α g *
                                            RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α
                                              (V ω + M.mulVec g) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r)
                                      μ) ∧
                                ∫ (ω : Ω),
                                    ∑ α,
                                      ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                        c α g *
                                          RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α
                                            (V ω + M.mulVec g) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r ∂μ ≤
                                  4 * C₀ * s.bandwidth * κ *
                                    ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), B g ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_cubicUnweightedCorrection
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p r K : ℕ},
  1 ≤ p →
    ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
      Measurable V →
        ∀ (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (σ : ℝ) {C₀ δ κ : ℝ},
          0 < C₀ →
            0 < κ →
              δ ≤ s.bandwidth →
                RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V μ) C₀ δ κ →
                  (∀ (j : Fin p), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (A j) = 1) →
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                        (fun ω =>
                          ∑ α,
                            RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorMass s (σ • A) (V ω) α *
                              (1 +
                                RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq
                                  (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMean (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id fun g =>
                                    RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α ((σ • A).mulVec g + V ω))))
                        μ ∧
                      ∫ (ω : Ω),
                          ∑ α,
                            RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHSelectorMass s (σ • A) (V ω) α *
                              (1 +
                                RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq
                                  (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMean (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id fun g =>
                                    RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α ((σ • A).mulVec g + V ω))) ∂μ ≤
                        4 * C₀ * s.bandwidth * κ +
                          (Real.exp (13 / 2) + 8) * (↑K + 1) * (4 * C₀ * s.bandwidth * κ) * RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p
